data.long_meaning: The name Bickart is of Germanic origin, derived from the Old High German words 'bic' meaning 'bright' and 'hart' meaning 'spear'. This name could be given to a child believed to be as strong and shining as a spear. The name Bickart carries the meaning “Bright spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bickart usually hope their child will grow to embody bright spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
